The $16.5 billion Sacramento County Employees’ Retirement System in California added a buyout fund to its private equity portfolio, according to recent meeting disclosures. The public pension, which relies on consultant Cliffwater for its alternative investment portfolio, has generated a 15.2% net IRR in private equity since inception.
